requirement: Implement RulePipeline with proper closure scope binding in generator and scaler loops, boundary validation, and history management.
skeleton: RulePipeline class with register_threshold_checks, build_indexed_scalers, evaluate, and clear methods.

rationale.teaches: Late-binding closures in loops: capture the loop variable through a default argument, reject an empty factor list, allow exactly 20 thresholds, require all rules to pass, and clear history fully.
rationale.why: A closure over a loop variable returns the last value for every scaler, a bug that is only visible when more than one closure is called after the loop ends. The fixture builds several and calls each.

candidates.why_wrong: The lambda closes over the loop variable, so every scaler multiplies by the last factor.
An empty factor list is accepted and yields no scalers instead of raising ValueError.
Exactly 20 thresholds is rejected even though 20 is the documented maximum.
evaluate passes when any rule holds instead of all, so a value failing one threshold is accepted.
clear leaves the evaluation history in place, so history grows across resets.
